### Deals and Pipelines {slug: crm/deals}
Get here: In the left menu, click "Deals".
- Deal = sales opportunity; pipeline = its stages. Board: one column per stage. Phone shows "Open this on a computer".
- "View settings": "Layout" ("Board"/"Table"), "Group by" ("Stage" default), "Show field labels", "Hide empty fields", "Compact cards".
- The picker shows one pipeline; a saved view can show All pipelines. Board dragging works only within a deal's own pipeline; use "Move pipeline" in "Table".
- New pipeline: picker > "New pipeline" > template or "Custom Pipeline" > "Pipeline Name" > "Pipeline Stages" (unique names, probability 0-100, tick "Won"/"Lost", "Add Stage") > "Create Pipeline". Needs one Won and one Lost stage; the last of either can't be removed. "Edit pipeline" > "Update Pipeline". "Delete pipeline": stages go too, stages holding deals must be emptied first, permanent.
- Add: "New deal" or a column's "+" > "Create Deal". Required: "Deal Name", "Pipeline", "Stage". Optional: "Amount", "Currency" (USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD), "Value period" ("One-off", "Monthly", "Annual"), "Description", "Win Probability (%)", "Source", "Owner", "Contacts", "Companies".
- Interested replies or booked meetings via the Cold Email Agent or AI SDR can create a deal; opens and clicks don't. Missing old deal: add by hand. Recent: support chat with campaign name and reply date.
- Move: drag; card three dots > "Move to stage"; "Advance stage" (never to Won/Lost; then "Mark won"/"Mark lost"). Won/Lost deals aren't locked. Stuck: refresh.
- "Table" bulk: "Change owner", "Change stage", "Move pipeline", "Update tags". "More": "Import deals", "Export this view".
- Delete: card three dots > "Delete" > confirm; deal and stage history removed for good; people stay.
- No stage to pick: create a pipeline first.

The records in the app are the source of truth.

### Manage Your Personal Account {slug: account-settings}
Get here: Click your workspace name in the top-left corner, click "Settings", then click "Profile" under "Account" in the left menu.

Personal settings follow you across all workspaces. On older workspace pages, click a setting's own save or update button after each change.
Pages: "Profile", "Notifications", "Appearance", "Security"; under "Your calendar": "Email & Calendar", "Availability", "Conferencing".

**Profile**
- Name: edit "Your name", click "Save changes". Shows in all workspaces right away.
- Email: "Update your email", enter "New email", click "Send confirmation". Click the link in your current inbox, then the link in the new inbox. Nothing changes until both are done; keep using the old email to log in. Links last about 10 minutes; if expired, submit again. Check spam.
- Photo: "Profile picture" > "Upload" (PNG or JPG), crop, save. "Remove" takes it off.

**Appearance**: "Light", "Dark", "System" (matches computer). Applies instantly.

**Security**
- "Password": enter current and new, "Save changes". New: 12+ characters, under 73, upper and lowercase, a number. Signs out other devices. Forgot: "Email me a link". Social login without password: "Set password" emails a link.
- "Two-step sign in": "Authenticator app" > "Set up", password, "Continue", scan code, enter 6-digit code, "Turn on", save backup codes (each works once, not shown again), "Done". Off: "Turn off…". Needs a password.
- "Sign-in methods": "Email and password", "Google" ("Connect" or "Disconnect…"). Google can't be disconnected if it's your only way in until you add a password.
- "Active sessions": sign-out button per device; "Sign out of other sessions…".

**Availability**
- Timezone and "Buffer times" ("Before each meeting", "After each meeting": "No buffer", "5 minutes", "15 minutes", "30 minutes") save straight away. AI SDR booking offers avoid buffers.
- Working hours: turn day on, set times, "+" for more blocks, "Save changes". A day turned on without times gets 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Copy: copy icon, tick days, "Copy to … days", "Save changes".
- "Booking link": must start with https://, "Save changes". AI SDR includes it when a prospect asks to book.

**Email & Calendar**
- "Connected accounts": "Connect Google" or "Connect Outlook" (or "Connect account"). Up to 5. Disconnecting removes it from all workspaces. Calendar not showing means no account is connected.
- Calendar (saves straight away): "Put new meetings on" (none: people can still book, but meetings don't show in your calendar); "Busy times come from"; "Show my event names to my team" (off: teammates see "External Event"; Acquisity meetings always show). Google holiday calendars for the US, Canada, Spain block public holidays; observances stay bookable; UK, Australian and other-language calendars block nothing.
- "Email": switch on Gmail to sync last 90 days into this workspace, per workspace; nothing leaves your inbox. Outlook shows status only. Paused until reconnected if needed.
- "Add new people from email" ("Only people already in your CRM", "Also add people you email") and "Track email opens and clicks": Admin or Owner only.
- "Email signature": per account, "Add signature" or "Edit", "Use workspace template", "Save changes".

**Conferencing**: "Meeting link type": "Your personal link" (paste, "Save") or "Zoom" ("Connect Zoom"; new link each meeting).

**Delete account**: "Profile" > "Danger zone" > "Delete account", review workspaces, type DELETE, confirm. Deletes workspaces where you're sole owner and cancels billing. Restore within 30 days by signing in with the same email, ticking workspaces, "Restore my account". After that it's permanent.

### Complete the Guided Setup {slug: onboarding}
Get here: "Settings" > "General", "Onboarding" section

b6f3094eef87cf3c6796a730b3206235922fdfa5:
### What are the steps to launch my first campaign? {slug: onboarding/faq/what-are-the-steps-to-launch-my-first-campaign}
